standard-dialogue-without-at-least-100-c.npc: Well met, fellow adventurer! How can I help you?

options.text: Who are you?

steps.npc: How frightfully rude of me, my dear [chap/girl]. My name is Odovacar and I work for that excellent enterprise, the Bank of Gielinor.

options.text: If you work for the bank, what are you doing here?

steps.player: If you work for the bank, what are you doing here?

steps.npc: As part of our ongoing service to provide you, the customer, with an absolutely world-class banking experience, we are investigating the option of opening a chain of travelling banks. These will provide you, our
esteemed customer, with the convenience of having banking facilities where they will be of optimum use to you. Such as here!
I am the first of a new generation of travelling bankers that will wander the perilous areas of the world to provide you, the valued customer, with a bank when you need it most!

steps.player: So I can access my bank account simply by talking to you?

steps.npc: Absolutely correct, dear [sir/lady]. I must warn you, however, that due to the significantly increased overheads of an enterprise such as this, there is a small bank charge of 100gp every time you want to access your account.

options.text: I don't have the money. Can I get it from my bank?

steps.player: I don't have the money. Can I get it from my bank?

steps.npc: It's not that I don't trust you to pay afterwards, old [chap/girl], but as the old adage goes, 'money comes before friends'.

options.text: That's preposterous! I'm not paying to withdraw my own money!
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
I'd like to access my bank account, please.

steps.npc: I'm afraid you don't have the necessary funds with you at this time so I can't allow you to access your account. Please come again, when you have 100 gold to cover the fee.

options.text: I'd like to check my PIN settings.

steps.player: I'd like to check my PIN settings.

options.text: I'd like to collect items.

steps.npc: I'm afraid you don't have the necessary funds with you at this time so I can't allow you to collect your items. Please come again, when you have 100 gold to cover the fee.
